content.short: Dwellir operates RPC and API infrastructure across 150+ blockchain networks.
content.description: Dwellir runs RPC infrastructure across more than 150 blockchains, offering both full and archive nodes through HTTPS and WebSocket endpoints. Its Hyperliquid endpoints cover the EVM layer, and it is one of the few providers listed in the documentation of Monad, Hyperliquid and Robinhood Chain alike. Customers connect with an API key from the platform dashboard. Archive coverage extends to Base, Ethereum, BNB Chain and Polygon among others.
